{"people":[{"name":"Tom","role":"Account executive (rep)","side":"us"},{"name":"PMM","role":"Product marketer (interviewer)","side":"us"},{"name":"(unnamed)","role":"Our solutions engineer","side":"us"},{"name":"Angela","role":"COO; signed with Adyen","side":"customer"},{"name":"Raj","role":"CTO; ran the RFP; rep's main contact","side":"customer"},{"name":"Bev","role":"Head of store operations","side":"customer"},{"name":"(unnamed)","role":"Ecommerce lead","side":"customer"}],
"competitors":["Adyen"],
"incumbent":"Not named. The transcript mentions only separate store and web systems with 'two different customer records' and 'the old tills'.",
"evidence":[
{"id":"E1","turn":2,"excerpt":"Returns. Last holiday season. Buy online, return in store. The store couldn't see the online order","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Core trigger: cross-channel returns failed during the holiday peak."},
{"id":"E2","turn":2,"excerpt":"staff were refunding to gift cards or telling people to mail it back","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Concrete operational pain at the store level."},
{"id":"E3","turn":2,"excerpt":"they'd just launched a loyalty program that was supposed to work everywhere and didn't, because store and web were two different customer records","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Second trigger: split customer records broke the loyalty program."},
{"id":"E4","turn":2,"excerpt":"Their COO, Angela, apparently stood in a store on December 27th watching the returns queue. That's the story everybody there tells.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["trigger","decider"],"note":"Hedged hearsay. Ties the trigger to Angela early, which foreshadows her as the decider."},
{"id":"E5","turn":4,"excerpt":"The CTO, Raj.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Rep's initial claim about who decided. He later reverses it."},
{"id":"E6","turn":4,"excerpt":"He ran the RFP, he was my contact the whole way.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"The rep's basis for naming Raj is contact and process, not signature authority."},
{"id":"E7","turn":6,"excerpt":"This is secondhand. Raj told me afterwards.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"All competitor information comes through Raj after the deal."},
{"id":"E8","turn":6,"excerpt":"they came in with a retail team, people who'd done store rollouts","label":"fact","speaker":"Raj (CTO), relayed by rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Adyen staffed people with store rollout experience."},
{"id":"E9","turn":6,"excerpt":"they talked about one platform for the tills and the website, on one contract","label":"fact","speaker":"Raj (CTO), relayed by rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["competitor","language"],"note":"Adyen used the customer's own framing (tills + website, one contract)."},
{"id":"E10","turn":6,"excerpt":"And they named retailers Angela knew. That's what Raj said. I wasn't there.","label":"fact","speaker":"Raj (CTO), relayed by rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["competitor","gaps"],"note":"Adyen offered peer references Angela knew. We could not."},
{"id":"E11","turn":8,"excerpt":"Before, it was all web. Conversion, checkout, wallets. After, it was stores.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor","decided"],"note":"The customer's focus shifted to stores after meeting the competitor."},
{"id":"E12","turn":8,"excerpt":"What happens when the store wifi drops. How do you roll out 120 stores. Who shows up when a till goes down on a Saturday.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["competitor","language","gaps"],"note":"Store-operations questions, in customer terms (till, 120 stores)."},
{"id":"E13","turn":8,"excerpt":"Raj forwarded me a list of 14 questions and 11 of them were about stores.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor","decided"],"note":"Documented shift: 11 of 14 questions were about stores."},
{"id":"E14","turn":10,"excerpt":"Reaction: the online checkout demo. Their ecommerce lead loved it. The wallets, the one-click piece.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"The web demo landed, but with the ecommerce lead, not the decider."},
{"id":"E15","turn":10,"excerpt":"Silence: the unified commerce part. I had the slide.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language"],"note":"Our core unified commerce message got no reaction."},
{"id":"E16","turn":10,"excerpt":"Online and in-store on one platform, the line between them has pretty much disappeared.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep (our slide)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language"],"note":"Our pitch wording. Abstract compared with the customer's 'tills' language."},
{"id":"E17","turn":10,"excerpt":"that's a diagram.","label":"quote","speaker":"Bev (head of store operations)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Store ops dismissed the slide as unproven."},
{"id":"E18","turn":10,"excerpt":"Then she asked how a return works. Step by step. At the till.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","gaps","language"],"note":"Bev wanted the trigger scenario shown concretely."},
{"id":"E19","turn":12,"excerpt":"I described it.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","message"],"note":"Described, not demonstrated. A recurring gap."},
{"id":"E20","turn":14,"excerpt":"I brought our solutions engineer and me. They had six people from store operations.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","gaps"],"note":"We sent 2 people against their 6 at the store workshop."},
{"id":"E21","turn":14,"excerpt":"Nobody on our side had run a store rollout.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","competitor"],"note":"Contrasts with Adyen's retail rollout team."},
{"id":"E22","turn":14,"excerpt":"When Bev asked who does the installs, I said we'd bring in a partner. She wrote something down and didn't ask another question.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","gaps"],"note":"Likely loss moment: partner answer on installs."},
{"id":"E23","turn":14,"excerpt":"I knew on the drive home.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Rep's own sense of when the deal was lost."},
{"id":"E24","turn":14,"excerpt":"Right before that, honestly, we were ahead. Raj said so. We'd won the web side.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["decided","outcome"],"note":"Based on Raj, who was not the signer. The web lead did not decide the deal."},
{"id":"E25","turn":16,"excerpt":"Angela's team. Stores.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","decided"],"note":"Angela's stores team drove the decisive workshop."},
{"id":"E26","turn":18,"excerpt":"Angela.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","outcome"],"note":"Angela signed with Adyen."},
{"id":"E27","turn":20,"excerpt":"...Probably Angela. Raj wanted us. I think. He told me he did.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Self-correction on the decider. Raj's support is hedged."},
{"id":"E28","turn":22,"excerpt":"Once. The kickoff.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","gaps"],"note":"Met the actual decider only once."},
{"id":"E29","turn":24,"excerpt":"A retailer they could call. We sent a case study.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"They asked for a live reference and got a document."},
{"id":"E30","turn":24,"excerpt":"can I talk to them?","label":"quote","speaker":"Angela (COO)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"The decider asked directly for a peer reference."},
{"id":"E31","turn":24,"excerpt":"we couldn't set up a call in time","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Unmet reference request. Adyen named retailers Angela knew."},
{"id":"E32","turn":24,"excerpt":"Then a rollout plan. Dates, who installs, what happens to the old tills.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Second gap: no rollout plan."},
{"id":"E33","turn":24,"excerpt":"They wanted to watch an online order get returned at a store till, live. We described it. We never showed it.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","trigger"],"note":"We never demonstrated the exact trigger scenario."},
{"id":"E34","turn":26,"excerpt":"One system for the tills and the website.","label":"quote","speaker":"Bev (head of store operations)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Customer's framing, repeated 'every time'. Matches the competitor pitch."},
{"id":"E35","turn":26,"excerpt":"I don't want two vendors pointing at each other.","label":"quote","speaker":"Angela (COO)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","gaps"],"note":"Our partner-for-installs answer creates exactly this risk."},
{"id":"E36","turn":26,"excerpt":"one customer, one basket.","label":"quote","speaker":"Angela (COO) (attribution implied, not explicit)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","trigger"],"note":"Echoes the loyalty and split-records trigger."},
{"id":"E37","turn":26,"excerpt":"They never said \"unified commerce.\" We kept saying \"in-person payments\" and \"point of sale.\" They said \"the tills.\"","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","message"],"note":"Explicit vocabulary mismatch."},
{"id":"E38","turn":28,"excerpt":"I think we had the better product online. I still think that.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome"],"note":"Rep still frames the deal around web, which is not what was decided."}
],
"contradictions":[
{"evidence":["E5","E26","E27"],"what":"Rep first names Raj (CTO) as the decider. He then reveals that Angela (COO) signed and revises to 'Probably Angela'."},
{"evidence":["E5","E28"],"what":"Rep worked with Raj 'the whole way' but met the actual decider, Angela, only once."},
{"evidence":["E24","E13","E22"],"what":"Rep says 'we were ahead' and 'won the web side'. The documented question shift (11 of 14 about stores) shows the evaluation had already moved to stores."},
{"evidence":["E27"],"what":"Rep hedges Raj's support within one line: 'Raj wanted us. I think. He told me he did.'"},
{"evidence":["E38","E26"],"what":"Rep still believes we had the better online product, yet the deal was decided on stores by the store-side COO."}
],
"dodges":[
{"question":"Who made the final call, and how do you know?","turn":4,"what":"Rep named Raj based on his RFP role and contact. He did not say how he knew. It was contradicted at T18-T20."},
{"question":"What did you say?","turn":12,"what":"Answered 'I described it.' with no detail on how he handled Bev's till-return question."},
{"question":"Anything else?","turn":28,"what":"Rep fell back on his opinion that our online product was better rather than adding new evidence."}
],
"skipped":[],
"language_pairs":[
{"theirs":"the tills","ours":"in-person payments / point of sale","evidence":["E37"]},
{"theirs":"One system for the tills and the website.","ours":"unified commerce / Online and in-store on one platform, the line between them has pretty much disappeared.","evidence":["E34","E16","E37"]},
{"theirs":"one customer, one basket.","ours":"unified commerce","evidence":["E36","E15"]},
{"theirs":"I don't want two vendors pointing at each other.","ours":"we'd bring in a partner","evidence":["E35","E22"]},
{"theirs":"how a return works. Step by step. At the till.","ours":"Online and in-store on one platform","evidence":["E18","E16"]}
],
"outcome_signals":[
{"evidence":["E26"],"what":"Lost. Angela (COO) signed with the competitor Adyen."},
{"evidence":["E22","E23"],"what":"Rep places the loss at the store ops workshop, after the partner answer on installs."},
{"evidence":["E24","E14","E38"],"what":"The rep says we 'won the web side', but the transcript does not say any part of the business moved to us. Adyen pitched tills and website 'on one contract'. The scope of the Adyen win is not stated."}
]}

contradictions.what: Rep first names Raj (CTO) as the decider. He then reveals that Angela (COO) signed and revises to 'Probably Angela'.
Rep worked with Raj 'the whole way' but met the actual decider, Angela, only once.
Rep says 'we were ahead' and 'won the web side'. The documented question shift (11 of 14 about stores) shows the evaluation had already moved to stores.
Rep hedges Raj's support within one line: 'Raj wanted us. I think. He told me he did.'
Rep still believes we had the better online product, yet the deal was decided on stores by the store-side COO.
